title: @csp/spec schemas + @csp/engine deterministic runner + run manifest + double-run replay test
context: citizen-science-pipelines is an open, reusable, reproducible toolkit for cleaning, validating, labeling, and de-identifying citizen-science data. This task builds the spine: the @csp/spec contract types/JSON Schemas and the deterministic @csp/engine reference executor. Reproducibility is a non-negotiable, test-enforced invariant (same inputs + same spec => byte-identical output), so the engine must forbid non-deterministic operations and emit a complete W3C-PROV-style run manifest. Depends on csp-repo-001 scaffolding.
objective: Implement @csp/spec (PipelineSpec, ValidationRule, CleaningTransform, PrivacyRule, ChangeLedgerEntry, ValidationReport, RunManifest as TypeScript types + ajv JSON Schemas) and a deterministic @csp/engine that runs an ordered pipeline with a fixed seed and emits a complete run manifest, with a double-run byte-identical replay test in CI.
acceptanceCriteria: @csp/spec defines and JSON-Schema-validates PipelineSpec, ValidationRule, CleaningTransform, PrivacyRule, ChangeLedgerEntry, ValidationReport, and RunManifest
Engine runs an ordered pipeline with a fixed seed and emits a complete W3C-PROV-style manifest (inputs + content hashes, steps + config hashes + tool versions, outputs + hashes)
Double-run replay test: running the same spec on the same inputs twice yields byte-identical output; CI fails on any diff
Non-deterministic operations (unseeded RNG, wall-clock, locale-dependent sort) are statically forbidden or linted
pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass; changeset added for the user-facing spec/engine packages
output: A PR adding @csp/spec (types + ajv JSON Schemas) and the deterministic @csp/engine with run-manifest emission and a passing double-run byte-identical replay test in CI.
